declaration: Each mode supplies a static public-contract-only narrative template at source admission before data access. Its authoring provenance/cost is recorded in source-admission/setup; no extra uncharged model session is inferred. A source-owned deterministic builder fills public probability counts/entropy only after all936 candidate predictions seal. It receives no labels/training/queryfeatures/provider and cannot feed anything to candidate episodes. Narrative quality is not automatically scored.
design_counts: 11306 logical phases include policy work within936 candidate_author_and_policy phases;22 API nodes split that composite for information-boundary clarity. Logical phases are not physical process counts.
precedence: These clarifications define the exact meaning of barrier, shuffle and declaration in all final design files; no scientific source executed.
protected_targets: Trusted input preparation must read original observed-key logs to create training projections and seal a separate outer-target vault. Those real protected observations/read costs are recorded. The prescore barrier governs first scoring-consumer access to that vault and prohibits all candidate/reference accesses, not a false claim that the trusted preparer read zero target bytes. Reference training labels are allowed only for exact current training support.
shuffle: Outer permutation is within person/alias/session. An inner fit therefore cannot borrow the exact held-validation-person intersection, but could borrow held-out template-bucket features from an otherwise fitting person (excluded unused intersection). A05 prevents every non-fit-support feature from entering fit and leaves all validation inputs unshuffled; this is the reason for fit-local reshuffling.
